> interface std/iterator
export function* map<T, U, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, escaping transform: (T) => U uses E): Generator<U> uses E
export function* filter<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, escaping keep: (T) => bool uses E): Generator<T> uses E
export function* flatMap<T, U, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, escaping expand: (T) => Generator<U> uses E uses (E, alloc)): Generator<U> uses (E, alloc)
export function* take<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, count: int): Generator<T> uses E
export function* drop<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, count: int): Generator<T> uses E
export function* takeWhile<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, escaping keep: (T) => bool uses E): Generator<T> uses E
export function* dropWhile<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, escaping skip: (T) => bool uses E): Generator<T> uses E
export function* enumerate<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E): Generator<#[int, T]> uses E
export function* zip<A, B, effect E>(first: Generator<A> uses E, second: Generator<B> uses E): Generator<#[A, B]> uses (E, alloc)
export function* concat<T, effect E>(first: Generator<T> uses E, second: Generator<T> uses E): Generator<T> uses E
export function chunk<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, size: int): Option<Generator<Array<T>> uses (E, alloc)> uses alloc
export function window<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, size: int): Option<Generator<Array<T>> uses (E, alloc)> uses alloc
export function reduce<T, U, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, combine: (U, T) => U uses E, initial: U): U from initial uses E
export function toArray<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E): Array<T> from source uses E, alloc
export function forEach<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, visit: (T) => void uses E) uses E
export function some<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, predicate: (T) => bool uses E): bool uses E
export function every<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, predicate: (T) => bool uses E): bool uses E
export function find<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E, predicate: (T) => bool uses E): Option<T> from source uses E
export function count<T, effect E>(source: Generator<T> uses E): int uses E
